usedFor: Creators use Youtube Studio with “Get channel analytics” to pull a channel’s numbers on a schedule, and “Find channels” to look a channel up first.

bestTemplate.name: “Get channel analytics” in Youtube Studio
bestTemplate.why: It returns the channel’s performance numbers, which is what a weekly channel report needs.

watchOut: Youtube Studio has no trigger here, so a schedule starts the report; use “Find channels” when the step only knows the channel’s name.
